title: 04-network.md §6.1/§6.2 normative IID+primary derivation still shows rejected SHA-512 primary formula
description: Discovered fixing 98kb (which covered only §12.1/§12.2). spec/04-network.md §6.1 (line ~24) and §6.2 (lines 56-73) carry the SAME rejected LICHEN-native SHA-512 primary formula 98kb fixed in §12.1: §6.2 lines 60-71 show 'Primary 02xx address: addr[0]=0x02; addr[1..8]=SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7]; addr[8..16]=IID (lower 64 bits == IID)' and §6.1 line 24 references the unified derivation with IID binding. These contradict the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision (primary MUST equal upstream AddrForKey, bit-packed inverted key, no hashing; IID binding is link-local only). §6.2 is the normative block §12.1 cross-references, so leaving it stale re-introduces the same contradiction one section up. Fix: rewrite §6.2's primary-address pseudocode to upstream AddrForKey (invert; leading-1 count; drop first 0; bit-pack addr[2:16], discard trailing partial; no hashing), scope the IID binding to link-local, and adjust §6.1 line 24. Also audit 03-addressing.md:22 which embeds the same formula. Part of i72x migration sweep; coordinate with the pinned-vector corpus (test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json).
close_reason: Fix verified present on main (066140d2c8): §6.1/§6.2/§12 normative text = upstream AddrForKey, IID link-local only, 03-addressing.md:22 audited, examples match pinned vectors. 3 review passes: 2 PASS, 1 stray-patch-artifact finding filed separately.
